papers_and_supporting_note.scope: Every positive-growth continuous real PA PC reference on finite rational spatial domains of the specified unit-weight U3,4 six-cone carrier admits a nonnegative compactly supported nonseparable real PA obstacle with an actual PAPC envelope, exact exterior equality to the reference and complete negative recursive contact integral -8*epsilon*lambda^2. Explicit rho example has all nine atoms, total mass24 and integral-1/2. No original arbitrary-carrier classification, whole-pair regularity, PAPC+, higher-dimensional smoothness label, literal coefficient theorem or analytic realization.

continued_goal: All original atoms remain open; further research proceeds in small batches.
